title: Semilinear transport of scalar-extended complexes
statement: Let A0,A1,C0,C1 be commutative rings, f0:A0 to C0 and f1:A1 to C1 ring homomorphisms, and eA:A0 equiv A1 and eC:C0 equiv C1 ring equivalences satisfying eC after f0 = f1 after eA. Let K0 and K1 be integer cochain complexes over A0 and A1, and alpha an additive chain isomorphism satisfying alpha_n(a q)=eA(a) alpha_n(q). Then the complexes obtained by extending scalars along f0 and f1 and forgetting to additive groups have a chain isomorphism tau with tau_n(c tensor q)=eC(c) tensor alpha_n(q).

proof.text: View eC as an eA-semilinear equivalence between C0 and C1 with their scalar actions restricted along f0 and f1; compatibility of the two ring maps proves semilinearity. Each component of alpha is an eA-semilinear equivalence. TensorProduct.congr gives degreewise additive equivalences and their pure-tensor formula.

The chain identity of alpha identifies both compositions with the differentials on pure tensors. Tensor induction extends this to all tensors. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents supplies the chain isomorphism, with inverse provided by the inverse tensor equivalences.

proof_origin.note: Constructed and compiled in Lean, including all inverse and differential equations.

theorem exists_semilinearTensorComplexIso
    {A₀ A₁ C₀ C₁ : Type u}
    [CommRing A₀] [CommRing A₁] [CommRing C₀] [CommRing C₁]
    (f₀ : A₀ →+* C₀) (f₁ : A₁ →+* C₁)
    (eA : A₀ ≃+* A₁) (eC : C₀ ≃+* C₁)
    (h : eC.toRingHom.comp f₀ = f₁.comp eA.toRingHom)
    (K₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A₀) ℤ)
    (K₁ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A₁) ℤ)
    (α : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj K₀ ≅
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A₁) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj K₁)
    (hα : ∀ (n : ℤ) (a : A₀) (q : K₀.X n),
      α.hom.f n (a • q) = eA a • (show K₁.X n from α.hom.f n q)) :
    ∃ τ : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} C₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj (((ModuleCat.extendScalars f₀).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K₀) ≅
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} C₁) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj (((ModuleCat.extendScalars f₁).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K₁),
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (c : C₀) (q : K₀.X n),
        τ.hom.f n (c ⊗ₜ[A₀,f₀] q) =
          eC c ⊗ₜ[A₁,f₁] (show K₁.X n from α.hom.f n q)
